idea-plugin.name: Pi Selection
idea-plugin.description:
Integrates the Pi coding agent with your IDE: the current editor selection is automatically injected as context when you submit a prompt in Pi — no copy-pasting.

How it works
• The plugin runs a localhost-only service that tracks the active editor selection in real time (in memory, nothing written to disk)
• When you submit a prompt in Pi, a companion Pi extension fetches the current selection over HTTP and injects it as <idea-selection> context
• The same selection is injected only once; picking a new selection switches the context automatically; cancelling the selection stops injection
• A WebSocket channel keeps Pi's status widget updated with the current selection file and lines

Requirements
The companion Pi extension must be installed (one file, see project README).

Notes
• Listens on 127.0.0.1 only (ports 19232/19233), no external network access
• Single shared service across multiple open projects
• 兼容 Pi Agent：提交 prompt 自动注入 IDEA 当前选中代码，无需复制粘贴
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0:
• Initial release
• Real-time selection tracking (event-source editor, works with split editors and multiple projects)
• HTTP query API (127.0.0.1:19232) + WebSocket push (127.0.0.1:19233)
• Pull-based injection: Pi extension fetches the current selection at prompt time, no stale context
